audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows disagreed with their own why-text. win[1]/phases[1].side read 'Skill' while whys[1] says Akshan holds level 2; win[2] and win[3] read 'Yorick' while whys[2] says level 3 evens and whys[3] says levels 4-5 stay even; win[5] read 'Yorick' while whys[5] says the first-item window is even.
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Akshan, Akshan, Skill, Skill, Akshan, Skill, Yorick) agrees with every why line on the page. Avengerang out-ranges point-blank Last Rites for the first two levels, Mourning Mist and a ghoul buffer level it at 3, and only the 2-item side lane is decisively yours.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the packet across both layers as one atomic pair-matched group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike described Comeuppance as an 'execute' and treated Going Rogue only as mobility.
audit.why: Riot's text says Comeuppance stores bullets and deals damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion or structure hit — not a threshold execute. Going Rogue is camouflage, and its Scoundrel mechanic resurrects the allies a marked enemy killed, which is the real reason his 6 swings tempo.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now says missing-health, names the camouflage, and states the resurrect payoff.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places told you to cage Akshan or 'W-trap his E dash' (spikes[3].text, wants.you[1], dosFull[2].d). That is backwards and it gets players killed.
audit.why: Heroic Swing fires a grappling hook INTO terrain and swings around it. Dark Procession creates terrain. A wall placed behind Akshan is not a cage — it is the anchor he needs to arc out, and it is also destructible so he can simply break it. Same finding as the mirror audit (akshan__yorick), restated from your side.
audit.corrected: Wall lines now read 'across his path, never behind him', and state that Heroic Swing hooks terrain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentioned that Going Rogue is camouflage or that Yorick has no way to see through it.
audit.why: missingInteractions rule 'stealth-needs-vision': Akshan goes unseen and no ability in Yorick's kit reveals stealth, so a Control Ward and sweeper are mandatory rather than optional.
audit.corrected: mid now ends on buying a Control Ward and states you have no reveal; spikes[1].text adds sweeping for him.
sources: ownerKit — no revealsStealth flag on any slot

edits.before: Yorick pulls ahead 2+ items — you out-sidelane a squishy marksman, W-trap his E dash, and Maiden waves shove faster than he can answer. Force him into 1v1s where his roam value is neutralised and your ghouls overwhelm him.
edits.after: Yorick pulls ahead 2+ items — you out-sidelane a squishy marksman and Maiden shoves faster than he can answer. Never wall his exit: Heroic Swing hooks terrain, so Dark Procession behind him is his anchor out, not your cage.

edits.before: Akshan spikes at 6 — Comeuppance is a long-range execute and his W Going Rogue mobility lets him roam and reset picks off your team. Ping mid, hold W Cage for when he engages, and don't hug the wave where his E swing-line closes distance.
edits.after: Akshan spikes at 6 — Comeuppance is long-range missing-health damage and Going Rogue camouflage lets him roam and resurrect off picks. Ping mid, sweep for him, and place Dark Procession across his path, never as a wall he can hook and swing off.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 even out as your ghoul wave buffer and E slow let you contest CS, but he spikes again at 6: Comeuppance executes from range and W Going Rogue makes him a roam threat. Track his mid pathing and hold Cage for his engage.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 even out as your ghoul buffer and Mourning Mist's slow and armour shred let you contest CS, but he spikes at 6: Comeuppance hits from range and Going Rogue camouflages his roams. Buy a Control Ward — you have no reveal.

edits.before: W Cage to trap his E swing or all-in on mistake
edits.after: Cage across his path — E hooks terrain behind him

edits.before: Akshan wastes Heroic Swing — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Heroic Swing hooks terrain — cage him only while it is on cooldown.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A wall behind him is a grapple anchor — you gave him the exit.

notes: wants.you[1] is 46 characters before and 48 after, both over the 25-character skip floor, so it is measured — the ratio is +4.3% and inside the band. The single highest-value correction in this matchup is that Dark Procession is terrain and Heroic Swing grapples into terrain; the page said 'cage him' or 'trap his E' in four separate places and never once said the wall is destructible or that it can be used against you.
